text:
maria: FYI enterprise tenant acme-prod rotated their service key ~10m ago and now rerank calls return 403. embeddings and small generate calls sometimes work, but batch rerank is failing. request id from customer: prod-req-93a2. escalating.

sam: can you share the 403 body + a redacted curl? any X-Request-Id from our logs?

maria: 403 body: {"error":"forbidden","reason":"missing_entitlement:rerank"}
curl (redacted):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"inputs": ["doc1","doc2"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
Decoded token payload (redacted):
```
{
  "sub": "svc:acme-prod-1",
  "entitlements": ["inference","embeddings"],
  "exp": 1769999999
}
```
Note: portal shows the service key has generate, embeddings, rerank selected.

siva: token missing rerank entitlement explains 403. two likely vectors: provisioner dropped the scope during rotation, or an upstream proxy truncated JWT claim. any ingress/nginx logs?

ingress-bot: observed a JWT payload truncation event at 1769998910 for tenant acme-prod. client_header_buffer_size was hit (payload > default buffer) and nginx logged: "JWT payload truncated, claim length 6220 > client_header_buffer_size".

sam: oh — so if the claim array gets truncated at the boundary the last entitlement can disappear. if portal encodes entitlements as a flat CSV inside the claim or as an array, truncation can drop trailing items (like rerank).

maria: reproduced in staging by creating a svcacct with a long tenant label + many entitlements, then rotating via the portal. steps:
1) create svcacct with entitlements: [inference, embeddings, rerank, rerank-admin, audit, ...] (long list)
2) rotate key from portal UI
3) call /v1/rerank -> 403 missing_entitlement rerank
Decoded token showed entitlements array missing the last element (rerank).
Workarounds for customer: 1) generate key via admin API path that uses smaller claim packing (we have an API path that produces compact claims) OR 2) temporarily rotate after we bump the proxy buffer size.

siva: ops will increase client_header_buffer_size for the prod edge in the tenant's region and roll a config restart. scheduling change in ~20m. also adding a short-term rule to reject rotations that produce claim payload > 6k so portal can surface an error.

eng-ml-oncall: flagging eng-platform + product: consider two fixes: compress entitlements into a compressed claim (zlib/base64) and add an automatic fallback policy so that if a rerank entitlement is missing but customer has inference+embeddings and is enterprise, we can route to a hosted rerank path (needs product & legal signoff).

sam: filing internal ticket CS-7231 with repro artifacts, decoded token, nginx logs, and curl snippets. assigning to eng-platform.

maria: updated customer: ops is rolling a proxy config change; temporary workaround is to re-issue via admin API or wait 20m for ops. will follow up once ops confirms. :thumbsup: :eyes:

siva: ops change completed at 1769998918, logs show no further truncation events for acme-prod. please verify with customer.

maria: customer confirmed rerank calls succeed after re-issuing token. closing loop, will keep ticket open for platform fix and product discussion. thanks all :raised_hands:
